items.title: A Survey of Robotic Navigation and Manipulation with Physics Simulators in the Era of Embodied AI

items.title: Agentic Software Issue Resolution with Large Language Models: A Survey

items.title: Biomolecules under Pressure: Protein Phase Transitions from Folding to Misfolding, Aggregation, and Condensation
